ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily along the trailing edges and distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation zones occupy the proximal and central areas; distinct high-intensity white blobs are localized on the far distal trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive white mottling/stippling is visible along the inner trailing edges and surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and frequent serration; continuous series of small peaks and shallow valleys with a 2-5 pixel amplitude across both lobes, creating a ragged or frayed appearance.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-curved trajectory exhibiting distal convexity at the tips transitioning to a smooth concavity as the edges converge at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white clusters distributed across the mid-left lobe and the outer right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible as vertical and diagonal scratches on the right lobe; several smaller horizontal scratches are present on the medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks (linear scars) on the right lobe; extensive circular scarring across the distal regions of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A large, jagged high-intensity white patch on the distal corner of the right trailing edge.
